# Blind review protocol

Human development review resumed by user request on 2026-10-10. Interactive
readings include at most 80 lines of 80 characters, including instructions and
questions. Accepted labels and independent effectiveness claims retain their
review prerequisites. Use unchanged original source identities and frozen split
assignments. Implementers must not inspect holdout prose, labels or predictions
while tuning the candidate.

On 2026-10-13 the user requested unattended completion. Preserve the three
recorded human scopes and retire unanswered requests without inferred labels.
Separate blind agent reviews may supply development evidence, with actual agent
identifiers, exposure records and immutable original judgments. Multiple agents
do not supply independent human annotation, agreement or semantic-usefulness
evidence. Freeze each declared development batch before showing predictions.
Keep independent claims and the reserved holdout deferred when their human
prerequisites remain unavailable. The unattended session records the selection,
bindings, reports and policy decisions under
`quality/reviews/2026-10-13-autonomous/`.

The user subsequently resumed interactive human review. Keep the unattended
records frozen and start a fresh declared development batch. Exclude previously
scanned source IDs and native byte hashes when selecting fresh blind readings.
Record the returning human's alias and passage-specific prior prediction
exposure; unknown exposure remains unknown. Include a direct reading link within
the presentation limit. The resumed batch and source bindings are recorded in
`quality/reviews/2026-10-13-human-resume/`. Do not generate predictions for its
source until accepted initial batch labels are frozen.

## First pass

Give reviewers a fresh source-bound version 3 packet, declared rule contracts,
format/renderer limitations and necessary permitted source context. Withhold
predictions and native revisions. Record real reviewer identifiers and access
that fits the recorded source licenses. Sentence sources cannot establish
structural recall; unknown dialects and missing native project context require
unsupported coverage rather than a clean judgment.

For each rule and eligible source region, record independent issue spans,
intended meaning and a reason. Declare exhaustive reviewed coverage explicitly.
Unreviewed, unsupported and context-dependent regions remain distinct; unresolved
regions need an explanation and cannot supply clean negatives. Empty sources
still need an explicit review declaration for strict gating. Preserve exact
UTF-8 bytes and exclusive character endpoints. Validate the packet index,
source checksums, declared contracts, reviewer identity and review scopes before
accepting any report.

## Double annotation and adjudication

[The metadata-only subset](double-annotation-selection.json) preselects 23 units
across all 12 known source groups. Each group contributes one unit per available
format, then fills to two by the declared SHA-256 ranking; FastAPI has one
available unit. The seed is `proseprobe-p32-double-annotation-2026-10-10`.
Selection preceded predictions and labels and never opened holdout prose.

Have two reviewers work independently on this subset. Keep their original
judgments as separate artifacts. Record disagreements and denominators before
adjudication. Each adjudicated change needs reviewer identity, original source
and span, both judgments, final disposition and a rationale. Preserve unresolved
cases. Freeze accepted initial labels and exhaustive coverage before generating
predictions. Do not overwrite either review or silently refresh source/contract
checksums.

## Triggered findings and suggestions

After the blind pass is frozen, review triggered findings in a separately
identified pass. Trigger-only judgments support precision, not exhaustive recall.
Keep findings missed by the detector in the blind labels. Sparse purpose-written
positives/near misses remain a separate population.

Ask four questions independently: was the finding helpful, did the suggestion
fit the sentence, did it preserve intended meaning, and would the reviewer
accept it? Permit yes, no, context-dependent and unresolved answers; a missing
answer remains unreviewed. Bind every judgment to the exact source and full
diagnostic identity. Report the denominator and missing/unresolved quantities
for each question. A disposable exact-span rescan is mechanical evidence; it
cannot establish meaning preservation or semantic usefulness.

## Native revision pairs

Provide all four JFLEG and all ten ASSET references only after initial blind
review is frozen. Keep each original/reference bundle within its existing pair
and source group. Retain exact bytes and permitted local access. A reference is
an alternative revision, not an automatically clean source or an independent
sample. A paired comparison requires the same effective policy and actual runtime
source identity, with explicitly reviewed diagnostic correspondence and human
outcomes. Missing correspondence remains unavailable. Show warning changes
separately from semantic outcomes.

[The native edit mapping](native-edit-mapping.json) deliberately accepts no
ERRANT category as automatic rule truth. The native annotator ID and automated
error type remain available through the M2 reader. Token spans refer to the
visible tokenized sentence; insertions, deletions, alternative annotators and
preprocessing artifacts require context. Keep W&I noncommercial restrictions,
JFLEG CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and ASSET CC BY-NC 4.0 with their materials and permitted
outputs. LOCNESS and the unresolved README simplification package stay excluded.

## Uncertainty and holdout

Before interval implementation, the engineering method was declared as a
percentile bootstrap of whole identified source groups: 2,000 replicates,
seed 20261010, ratio of summed counts, and 95% percentile endpoints. Each metric
needs at least five contributing groups and a valid denominator. Keep all paired
variants together. Report group sizes and the dominant contribution share.
Clean reviewed groups can supply density evidence without precision events.
Intervals are conditional on observed pilot groups; they do not establish
representative population coverage. Too few groups and zero denominators
produce unavailable intervals with reasons.

Independent quality targets, semantic conclusions, candidate promotion and the
one-time holdout run await accepted development evidence. Declare populations, targets, minimum
sample/group support and the treatment of unavailable metrics before that run.
Freeze the candidate and initial adjudicated labels first. If holdout evidence
causes tuning, classify inspected material as development and reserve fresh
source groups. Do not reuse it silently for another independent claim.


## Interactive source presentation

Record the reading's source identity/hash, declared contracts, exact original
region and complete rendered-text hash before asking for judgments. Show explicit
physical line and exclusive character ranges for display continuations; preserve
literal chunks and original line endings in the reading map. The original bytes
stay unchanged. Reject an oversized reading instead of silently truncating it.

Retain literal answers separately from proposed annotation mappings. Confirm any
agent-derived interpretation or coordinates before accepting labels. A clean
answer covers only the displayed region and named rules; omitted text and rules
remain unreviewed. Missing context remains unsupported or context-dependent.
One session user supplies one review; independent double annotation requires a
second human reviewer. Keep predictions and native revisions withheld until the
accepted initial labels for the declared review batch are frozen.
